title: Rizzz.fun
tagline: A viral reel arena where watching and predicting turns into rewards.
description: Rizzz.fun is a social prediction arena where short videos compete and users earn by forecasting winners. Creators upload reels into live challenges, while viewers watch, predict outcomes, and compete for prize pools. Using Yellow Network sessions, users deposit once and make unlimited instant predictions off-chain with zero gas friction, settling on-chain at the end. Each user has a prediction passport stored in ENS, creating a portable on-chain identity that tracks reputation and performance. Rizzz.fun turns passive scrolling into a skill-based game economy where attention has value, combining creator competitions, crowd intelligence, and real-time rewards into a Web2-smooth experience secured by smart contracts.
how_its_made: Built with Next.js + Tailwind + wagmi/viem. Yellow state channels power gasless predictions with on-chain settlement. ENS “Prediction Passport” stores user strategy/preferences as portable identity. Custom Solidity contracts verify payouts with ECDSA proofs and time-weighted rewards.
